name: Can I prevent future window frame rot after a repair?

mainEntity.name: Can I prevent future window frame rot after a repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, several measures can help prevent future rot. Ensure proper drainage around windows, regularly inspect and maintain exterior caulking and paint, and address any leaks promptly. Improving interior ventilation can also reduce condensation. Using rot-resistant materials or treatments during the repair can also enhance durability. Regular maintenance checks are crucial, especially in moisture-prone areas like the Bay Area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent future rot by ensuring proper drainage, maintaining caulking and paint, addressing leaks, improving ventilation, and using rot-resistant materials.
